title: English Practice Quiz 0916
description: A ten-question English practice quiz covering grammar, vocabulary and practical communication.

questions.question: Segregating waste means ___.
questions.explanation: separating waste into appropriate categories is the correct choice based on the meaning and context of the question.

questions.question: A recycling symbol generally indicates an item ___.
options: may be recyclable under suitable local arrangements
questions.explanation: may be recyclable under suitable local arrangements is the correct choice based on the meaning and context of the question.

questions.question: An environmental audit may examine ___.
options: resource use, waste and compliance practices
questions.explanation: resource use, waste and compliance practices is the correct choice based on the meaning and context of the question.

questions.question: Why label chemical containers?
options: To identify contents and communicate hazards
questions.explanation: To identify contents and communicate hazards is the correct choice based on the meaning and context of the question.

questions.question: A spill should be handled by ___.
questions.explanation: following the relevant spill-response procedure is the correct choice based on the meaning and context of the question.

questions.question: Energy conservation at work can include ___.
options: switching off unused lights and equipment
questions.explanation: switching off unused lights and equipment is the correct choice based on the meaning and context of the question.

questions.question: Hazardous waste requires ___.
questions.explanation: appropriate handling and authorised disposal is the correct choice based on the meaning and context of the question.

questions.question: Environmental compliance means following ___.
questions.explanation: applicable environmental rules and requirements is the correct choice based on the meaning and context of the question.

questions.question: A water leak should be ___.
questions.explanation: reported promptly for repair is the correct choice based on the meaning and context of the question.

questions.question: Waste disposal records support ___.
questions.explanation: traceability and demonstration of compliance is the correct choice based on the meaning and context of the question.
